communication_breakdown.title: Communication breakdown detection
communication_breakdown.ground_truth_field: Person 1 / Communication Breakdown (NASA analyst-coded; non-blank = breakdown)

options.breakdown: The narrative describes a communication breakdown between people.
options.no_breakdown: The narrative does not describe a communication breakdown between people.

communication_breakdown.instructions: Read this aviation safety report narrative. Does it describe a communication breakdown, meaning information that was missed, misunderstood, not passed on, or not confirmed between the people involved in the event (for example pilot and controller, flight crew members, or crew and ground personnel)?

primary_problem.title: Primary problem category
primary_problem.ground_truth_field: Assessments / Primary Problem (NASA analyst-coded; 13 minor values grouped as Other)

options.Human Factors: The most prominent problem is human performance, such as fatigue, distraction, workload, situational awareness, training, or crew coordination.
options.Aircraft: The most prominent problem is an aircraft equipment or system malfunction or defect.
options.Procedure: The most prominent problem is a procedure, checklist, regulation or instruction that was missing, unclear, or not followed.
options.Ambiguous: No single problem clearly stands out; several factors contribute and none clearly leads.
options.Other: The most prominent problem is something else, such as weather, airport or airspace infrastructure, ATC equipment, charts or publications, company policy, or staffing.

primary_problem.instructions: Read this aviation safety report narrative. Which category best describes the most prominent problem in the event?
